answer: Mechanism: zero-knowledge non-membership proofs. Detected sybil clusters enter an on-ledger accumulator; every identity must periodically present a zero-knowledge proof that its key is in no flagged cluster, proving innocence without revealing its graph neighborhood. A shell inside a flagged fleet cannot produce the proof, so its rewards halt at the next checkpoint; escaping means leaving the cluster and writing off that branch's cost. Honest agents flash their proof like a comet each checkpoint, umber roots private, nectar flowing only to the provably unaffiliated.
